ns2:section.sectionText: *Eligible for PR minor This course will cover a variety of topics designed to help students learn more about social media analytics and network analysis in general. Course content will include an overview of human networks (i.e. positions of power, influence, and tie strength), an overview of tools available to analyze social media networks, and application of social media analytics to real life advertising and communications questions. If seats remain available, they will be released to juniors - seniors who are currently pursuing the PR Minor on April 30.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
